name: VolumeGeom
description: Geometry of the interaction between two LevelSet bodies when using volume-based interactions. Will soon become the general class for volume interaction, such that it works for polyhedra as well.

attributes.name: contactArea
attributes.description: Contact area perpendicular to the normal.

attributes.name: contactPoint
attributes.description: Contact point (global coordinates), centroid of the penetration volume.

attributes.name: penetrationVolume
attributes.description: Volume of the overlap or penetrating region.

attributes.name: shearInc
attributes.description: Shear displacement increment in the last step.
